fusions.name: Flying Shuttles
fusions.desc: A loom arm flings 3 threaded shuttles in a spread out to 6 tiles, each of which deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Seam Ripper
fusions.desc: Runs a motor-driven hook along the target's seams, which deals 18 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Lockstitch Suture
fusions.desc: A stitching arm closes your wounds and restores 16 health to you. The healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Ballistic Weave
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
